Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: express absolution
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: A stamped slip that wipes one memory of a broken commandment. The priest does not ask what you did.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: minor mercy
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: A blessed bandage, sold at the price of two doses of medicine. Heals one fresh wound of up to 10 hit points.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: certificate of unshaken faith
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: A framed certificate that says you never doubted. Raises certainty by ten percentage points.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: greater mercy
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: A priced miracle. Heals one lasting scar or old wound for good.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: ascension: seeker
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: Pay the entry fee and become a Seeker. A start, nothing more.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: ascension: adept
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: Rank II, Adept. From here on the holder may sell indulgences at the altar to guests and visitors of other houses.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: ascension: luminary
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: Rank III, Luminary. Light enough to be noticed from far away.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: ascension: ascendant
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: Rank IV, Ascendant. The top of the ladder, for those who can afford the view.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: psychic ascension
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: The priesthood pulls strings with something far above it. Raises the psylink by one level, up to the usual limit. Needs rank III.

Hearth.IndulgenceDef.label: reform tithe
Hearth.IndulgenceDef.description: A voluntary tithe towards the next reform of a fluid ideoligion: one reform point.
